purpose: AI-assisted preparatory study, not completed individual coursework or full main experiment
freeze: Freeze final program SHA256 before confirmation; no tuning after confirmation results. Record any correction and invalidate affected confirmatory interpretation.
primary_outcomes: lexicographic wins/ties/losses using integer connected-pair count then delivery_units
delivery_ratio difference conditional on equal connected pairs
optimal score match; cost/edge tie-breaking reported separately

uncertainty.cluster: same n and generation seed, retaining both budget conditions
uncertainty.strata: n6,n8,n10,n12; resample four graph clusters with replacement within each stratum
uncertainty.scope: descriptive intervals only; no significance threshold or unplanned best-method claim

missing_policy: Keep failures in success counts; no zero substitution. Pairwise score statistics use jointly successful rows and show denominators.

exact_study.note: Separate exact-search measurements; do not equate timing boundaries with web submissions.

limitations: n14 has only seeds0,1, so n14 is exploratory only
Synthetic fixed bank conditioned on exhaustive-reference feasibility
Small confirmation sample:16 graphs,32 dependent budget cases
Publication of bank references means held-out-by-workflow, not hidden evaluator test data
Agents must not read confirmation input/results until source freeze
AI-generated materials need human understanding, revision and execution per coursework rules
